newsitem.title: BELGIUM: GIB REPORTS MIXED SALES FOR EARLY 1997.
newsitem.headline: GIB REPORTS MIXED SALES FOR EARLY 1997.

text.p: Belgian retailer GIB reported on Wednesday mixed results for the the first four months of its 1997 year.

Supermarket, do-it-yourself and restaurant sales rose in some markets and market segments, but fell in others, chief executive officer Diego Du Monceau told the company's annual shareholders meeting. A text of his comments was released by the company.
"Seasonally adjusted figures for GB show a 1.6 percent rise in food sales and a 0.6 percent fall in non-food sales, with household goods suffering particularly badly," he said.
